business_objective: Build a high-converting, grounded developer creative package for Ollama local AI model runner, highlighting streamlined CLI setup and localhost REST API integration while honoring physical VRAM hardware realities.

observed_segments: Software developers, engineers, and AI builders on macOS, Linux, and Windows seeking local inference without cloud per-token costs or manual C++ compilation friction.
hypothesized_segments: Enterprise compliance teams and privacy-sensitive engineering leads evaluating offline AI architectures.

positioning.category_frame: Local LLM runtime and model orchestration CLI/API
positioning.core_promise: Single-command local AI execution on localhost:11434 with predictable zero-token cost
positioning.differentiating_mechanism: Automated backend dependency management (CUDA/quantization) wrapped in a unified localhost REST API service (port 11434)
positioning.unlike: Closed cloud APIs with per-token billing and data privacy concerns, or manual llama.cpp compilation

value_proposition: A streamlined developer gateway for local open-weight model execution on localhost port 11434 with predictable zero-per-token local compute and first-party privacy claims of offline data processing.
strategic_priorities: Position as fastest local developer setup wedge for open-weight models without manual compilation
Promote localhost REST API (port 11434) as a drop-in component for local development orchestration
Provide upfront model-to-VRAM hardware guidance to pre-empt low-spec CPU fallback latency disappointment
deferred_channels: Broad consumer social media paid ads (deferred due to lack of local GPU developer hardware fit)
Direct enterprise outbound field sales (deferred pending telemetry install baselines)
what_not_to_do: Will NOT market Ollama as a replacement for high-throughput enterprise production clusters without clarifying host VRAM prerequisites
Will NOT run aggressive direct-response paid ad spend against broad non-technical consumer audiences
Will NOT fabricate proprietary model benchmark claims; positioning remains strictly focused on runtime orchestration and developer UX

validated_recommendations.title: Local Developer Runtime Positioning Architecture
validated_recommendations.recommendation: Position Ollama as a streamlined CLI and localhost REST API runtime layer for local open-weight model execution across macOS, Linux, and Windows.
validated_recommendations.rationale: Provides developer convenience over manual C++ inference dependencies (llama.cpp/CUDA) and predictable, zero-per-token local execution.
assumptions: Target developers value local execution and predictable costs over cloud-managed API simplicity.
uncertainties: Paid enterprise conversion and telemetry install base remain unmeasured (TRANSACTION_DATA = MISSING).
validated_recommendations.stop_or_reconsider_condition: Reconsider if cloud API token prices fall so low that local runtime maintenance is economically non-compelling.

validated_recommendations.title: Developer Setup Friction Reduction Wedge
validated_recommendations.recommendation: Position Ollama as a streamlined local developer setup wedge for running open-weight models without manual compilation.
validated_recommendations.rationale: Sampled Hacker News developer discussions (N=25) confirm utility of automated CUDA setup and model abstraction.
assumptions: Automated setup is a primary decision factor for local developers.
uncertainties: Representative ecosystem-wide developer satisfaction remains unmeasured (REPRESENTATIVE_DEVELOPER_RECEPTION_DATA = MISSING).
validated_recommendations.validation_test: A/B test onboarding copy clarity against setup-related GitHub issue volume.
validated_recommendations.stop_or_reconsider_condition: Halt positioning if automated setup friction exceeds manual llama.cpp compilation.

validated_recommendations.title: Localhost REST API Promotion
validated_recommendations.recommendation: Promote the localhost REST API service (running on port 11434) as a drop-in integration layer for local workflow automation and script integration.
validated_recommendations.rationale: Verified in technical documentation and developer community samples.
assumptions: Developers desire local HTTP/REST API endpoints rather than CLI-only subprocess execution.
uncertainties: Concurrency scaling and multi-model routing constraints on local hardware.
validated_recommendations.validation_test: Track local API call activation velocity in sample developer workflows.
validated_recommendations.stop_or_reconsider_condition: Halt promotion if API endpoint compatibility issues cause widespread integration failures.

validated_recommendations.title: Transparent Model-to-Hardware VRAM Boundary Guidance
validated_recommendations.recommendation: Provide upfront, explicit hardware guidance (e.g., 4-5GB VRAM for 7B Q4, 8-10GB for 14B) to pre-empt CPU fallback latency disappointment.
validated_recommendations.rationale: Verified in technical documentation that low VRAM triggers slow CPU inference fallback.
assumptions: Upfront hardware transparency preserves developer trust and reduces early churn.
uncertainties: Exact hardware distribution among active user base is unknown (PRIVATE_TELEMETRY_DATA = MISSING).
validated_recommendations.validation_test: Compare onboarding retention between users seeing VRAM sizing tools vs generic download pages.
validated_recommendations.stop_or_reconsider_condition: Maintain permanently as core technical transparency guardrail.

validated_recommendations.title: Demand Creation Technical Architecture Guides
validated_recommendations.recommendation: Publish technical architecture teardowns and workflow automation guides showing how local inference addresses compliance and data sovereignty requirements.
validated_recommendations.rationale: First-party copy emphasizes offline execution and data privacy.
assumptions: Engineering teams in regulated domains seek offline local inference architectures.
uncertainties: Enterprise procurement cycles and decision-maker roles remain unvalidated.
validated_recommendations.validation_test: Engagement velocity and inbound technical inquiries generated from architecture teardowns.
validated_recommendations.stop_or_reconsider_condition: Pivot content strategy if compliance content fails to drive technical engagement.

validated_recommendations.title: Hypothesized Demand Capture via Technical Search
validated_recommendations.recommendation: Hypothesize technical search as a qualified developer acquisition channel, targeting queries like 'run llama locally' and 'offline llm runner' subject to keyword demand validation.
validated_recommendations.rationale: Search discovery identified active technical queries; demand magnitude requires empirical test.
assumptions: Sufficient commercial and technical search volume exists for local model runners.
uncertainties: Organic search impression-to-install conversion rate is unmeasured.
validated_recommendations.validation_test: Execute controlled search capture experiment to measure search intent and install rate.
validated_recommendations.stop_or_reconsider_condition: De-prioritize organic search if search traffic fails to generate active CLI sessions.

validated_recommendations.title: Trade-off: Do NOT Market as Production Cluster Replacement
validated_recommendations.recommendation: Explicitly avoid positioning Ollama as an enterprise high-throughput production cluster replacement without clarifying host VRAM prerequisites.
validated_recommendations.rationale: Physical hardware boundaries dictate inference throughput; misleading claims damage credibility.
assumptions: Brand credibility with technical developers requires strict adherence to physical compute realities.
validated_recommendations.validation_test: Monitor community sentiment and technical issue reports regarding performance expectations.
validated_recommendations.stop_or_reconsider_condition: Maintain permanently as core positioning constraint.

validated_recommendations.title: Trade-off: Do NOT Run Broad Consumer Ad Spend
validated_recommendations.recommendation: Explicitly avoid broad consumer paid ad campaigns across non-technical social channels.
validated_recommendations.rationale: Current evidence is strongly developer-oriented and does not establish broad consumer-market fit.
assumptions: Non-technical consumers lack motivation or workflow needs for local terminal/API model execution.
uncertainties: Potential consumer desktop GUI adoption remains unmeasured.
validated_recommendations.validation_test: Audit CAC against developer conversion baselines before allocating non-developer ad budget.
validated_recommendations.stop_or_reconsider_condition: Re-evaluate only if an end-consumer GUI app is released with verified consumer demand.

validated_recommendations.title: Trade-off: Do NOT Claim Proprietary AI Model Benchmarks
validated_recommendations.recommendation: Explicitly avoid claiming proprietary model benchmark leadership; maintain focus strictly on runtime orchestration, developer UX, and hardware boundary transparency.
validated_recommendations.rationale: Ollama orchestrates open-weight models (Llama, Mistral) rather than training proprietary weights.
assumptions: Developers evaluate Ollama on orchestration utility, not model weight architecture.
validated_recommendations.validation_test: Track developer brand perception as neutral model orchestrator.
validated_recommendations.stop_or_reconsider_condition: Maintain permanently as core brand distinction.

strategic_hypotheses: Upfront model-to-VRAM sizing guidance may reduce initial CLI onboarding drop-off caused by low-spec CPU fallback.
Enterprise compliance teams may prioritize data-residency and offline execution over cloud compute convenience.
Technical search capture targeting OpenAI API compatibility queries represents a viable developer acquisition channel.

experiments.change_or_treatment: Interactive model-to-VRAM sizing tool on landing page

experiments.stop_condition: Halt if calculator introduces excess friction

Do NOT invent unbacked numerical effect size percentages; use TO_BE_ESTABLISHED.
Do NOT invent fake software dashboard UIs, buttons, or unverified feature tabs.
first_party_claims: First-party copy emphasizes data privacy ('Your data is never trained on', 'Run entirely offline') (EVID-WEB-893338BD).
creative_constraints: Target audience: Technical software developers, ML engineers, script automators.
Visual tone: Clean, functional, terminal/code-native, engineering-focused.
Product behavior: Real CLI execution ('ollama run llama3'), localhost HTTP requests on port 11434.
success_definition: Coherent multi-asset creative package transforming grounded strategy into platform-ready creative assets with 100% claim discipline.
